content.comment_body: Hello, I am using [product_name] ([version_no], [version_no]) along with two inductive sensors for motor speed measurement. How can I display sensor values on the [product_name] display? Is it possible to transmit integer, real, or string data from [version_no] to [product_name] over a Profinet connection?

[product_name] only supports integer value processing. You can transmit integer values using Profinet. If you want to work with real data, you’ll need a dedicated conversion block, such as an F/I converter. For communication setup, it's recommended to configure [product_name] as the client and [version_no] as the server. You may review the example application titled '[document]' for further guidance.
Hello [user_name], Thank you for your response. The example was useful.

analysis.insight_summary: Users want to transfer various data types, including integer, real, and string, from a [version_no] device to a [product_name] module over Profinet. The feedback shows [product_name] can only process integer values directly; using real data requires a conversion block, and string transmission is unsupported or ambiguous. Users also appreciate detailed example documentation, but point out data type limitations which restrict their implementation options.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect an uncomplicated process to transmit integer, real, and string data types from [version_no] to [product_name] over Profinet, enabling flexible and straightforward data visualization on the [product_name] display.
